newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms buy 40,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms buy 40,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine companies have bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for March shipment at prices ranging from $153 to $180 per tonne FOB for various grades, traders said on Friday.

The traders said the firms bought 16,400 tonnes of western white wheat at an average $153 per tonne FOB from the Port of U.S. Pacific northwest, 11,700 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a protein content of 13.5 percent at $180 per tonne FOB, and 11,900 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a protein content of 14 percent at $184 per tonne FOB.
The wheat importation was done through a Japanese commodity house, traders said.
